svg.title: The first co-branded card across all Lazada markets
svg.desc: Led LazCard with VIB, with sign-up and identity checks inside the Lazada app, and brought VPBank on as a payments partner. Card orders got cancelled less and settled faster, and banks funded promotions. Lazada · bank partnerships · Best Employee Award 2023.
